purpose: Reference-only piecewise-period representation witnesses under existing native/wire contracts; no musical detector, optimized detector ceiling or production promotion.

witness_family.name: reference-anchored-constant-pieces-v1
witness_family.source_envelope: [first reference beat,last reference beat+1), never full-source coverage by assumption; declared unavailable PCM intersecting this envelope rejects the entire witness without bridging
witness_family.ownership: integer cell boundaries are first beat, floor((previous+current)/2)+1 for internal boundaries, last beat+1; each represented event must remain in its own cell, its exact nearest-reference Voronoi cell (ties earlier), and its original S6 window
witness_family.anchor: each contiguous segment starts exactly at its first reference event with that original global ordinal; single-beat segments permitted, no insertion or deletion
witness_family.phase_and_period: use the unchanged nearest-five-interval local reference period; phase error <=0.10*local_period minus one source frame and own segment period error <=0.01*local_period minus one source frame; conservative one-frame guard does not alter frozen scoring tolerances
witness_family.geometry: segment applicability runs from its first event's integer cell boundary to the boundary after its last event; previous natural line point must precede the range and next natural point must be at or beyond the range end, so declared counts cannot hide extra in-range line points
witness_family.junction: for a nonfinal segment require the interval from its last represented point to the next segment's exact reference anchor within 0.01*local_period_at_last minus one frame; final source successor remains unknown, not invented
witness_family.tempo_quantization: find the exact feasible integer Q32 period interval from phase/period/ownership/window/count/junction inequalities; intersect integer nominal tempos 40000..300000 whose floor((48000*60000<<32)/tempo) lies in that interval; choose nearest to the first reference event's rounded local tempo within this feasible interval, without rescuing an empty interval
witness_family.partition: dynamic programming minimizes segment count within this anchored family over every contiguous candidate; among equal-count solutions choose the longest first piece; deterministic tempo choice as above; no claim of global optimum over all possible grid anchors/representations
witness_family.capacity: compute and retain the complete minimum-count family witness before applying eight-segment wire cap; over-cap graphs may undergo native-only validation, but wire/builder adoption fails explicitly and no partial prefix is scored as success
witness_family.meter: reuse the two-equal-complete-bars rule on original reference indices per S6 window, map that downbeat ordinal to this witness's Q32 point, clip its range to the reference envelope, retain numerator/denominator and exact whole-frame binding; no unsupported meter or source prefix/suffix is filled
witness_family.state: all graphs/meters provisional, pending revision, confidence uncalibrated zero, selected TEMP equals first segment's actual nominal tempo and existing dynamic flags permit differing segment tempos

native_checks.scope: separate host-only Rust example using actual unchanged grid::validate_external/write/strict parse/canonical write, native_validation and external builder with same-grid MTRD included
native_checks.identity: Python expansion and Rust beat_at expansion must agree exactly on every Q32 coordinate and original ordinal; compare approximation to original reference separately, never call it lossless reference preservation
native_checks.meter: MTRD write/parse/grid lookup and complete native/builder cross-feature validation; no isolated meter-payload-only acceptance claim
native_checks.consumer: production M1 converter, dependency pin and owner handoff unchanged; prior actual-consumer audit remains the boundary, no new playback adoption

evaluation.control: reproduce all old coarse/Beat This OLS tuples, per-window scores and prior reference-only constant-fit witnesses; original score_window unchanged
evaluation.diagnostics: unchanged common point/period/one-to-one score on own segment periods, and separately on actual outgoing successor intervals including junctions; final source successor unknown; report full native-family witness and separately wire-cap-qualified witness across all 600 windows
evaluation.denominators: original 401 complete-reference contexts and 199 incomplete retained; report all 106 prior constant-period-incompatible windows separately, without selecting or dropping sources
evaluation.integrity_stop: immediate failure on baseline/hash/Q32/ordinal/meter mismatch; cap/unsupported-family outcomes remain explicit diagnostics, never trigger threshold or limit rescue
evaluation.evidence_level: label-based representation feasibility only; no detector accuracy, musical promotion, training/transfer, calibrated confidence or physical qualification
